name: cavemio-dialog
title: Dialog
description: A decision that needs the whole screen: the page fades back under a veil of its own colour and the panel rises out of a blur.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Built on the native <dialog> (modal.ts, shared with the other modal surface): focus stays inside, the page is inert, Escape works, and it sits in the top layer.
- Reduced motion: it fades.
- Buttons stack full-width on phones, primary last.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: title / description
props.description: – · Heading and the line under it (aria-labelledby / describedby).

props.description: true · A press on the veil closes it.

features.title: Native dialog

features.title: Bottom on phones

states.title: open
states.description: Veil fades in (260ms); the panel rises 8px from 0.96 out of a 4px blur (420ms).

states.title: close
states.description: Escape, ✕ or the veil; it sinks back (220ms) and focus returns.

states.title: long content
states.description: The body scrolls inside the panel; the page stays still.
